CommunityApplications.Profile: unraid-plugin-komari-agent packages the Komari monitoring agent for Unraid. The agent reports CPU, memory, disk, network throughput, load and uptime to a Komari status panel over a WebSocket connection. Unraid has no systemd and nowhere to keep a daemon's state, so this plugin supplies the missing layer: an rc script, a supervisor that restarts the agent when it crashes, log rotation, a flash-resident binary cache that survives the overlay filesystem being reset on every boot, and a Settings page that edits the configuration and shows live status. The upstream binary is redistributed unmodified from the official GitHub Release and is verified against a pinned SHA256 on every build. Remote control and self-update are disabled by default. The repository contains the plugin definition, the Slackware packaging, the WebGUI pages and the build and verification scripts.
